description: Dart source file for Flutter mobile app, implementing a map screen with clustering, charger markers, filters, and API interactions for charging stations.

classes.name: ChargerItem
classes.description: Model representing a charging station with identifier, name, location, and metadata.

classes.name: ChargerApi
classes.description: API client for fetching charger data from backend based on map bounds and filters.

classes.name: ChargerMapScreen
classes.description: Main stateful widget displaying map with clustering, filters, charger details, and user location.

methods.name: fetchChargers
methods.description: Fetches list of chargers within the provided map bounds, applying optional filters.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the state object for ChargerMapScreen, initializing map, API, and clustering.

methods.name: _initLocation
methods.description: Initializes user's current location and camera position.

methods.name: _initCluster
methods.description: Initializes the cluster manager for marker clustering.

methods.name: _markerBuilder
methods.description: Builds markers for clusters or individual charger items.

methods.name: _clusterIcon
methods.description: Generates bitmap icons for cluster markers based on size.

methods.name: _updateMarkers
methods.description: Updates the set of displayed markers.

methods.name: _onMapCreated
methods.description: Handles map creation and triggers initial data load.

methods.name: _reloadDataFromVisibleRegion
methods.description: Fetches charger data based on the current visible map region.

methods.name: _onCameraMove
methods.description: Handles camera movement by updating cluster manager.

methods.name: _onCameraIdle
methods.description: Handles camera idle event to update clustering and data fetch.

methods.name: _toggleFilters
methods.description: Toggles visibility of the filters UI.

methods.name: _applyFilters
methods.description: Applies filter settings and reloads charger data.
